actionSegments.name: Category buyer: legacy, disengaged
actionSegments.description: Category buyers who also hold company investments but have not made a council investment in the past six months.
actionSegments.strategy: Use reactivation journeys, portfolio reminders and timely new council launches to bring them back into the council category.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Keeps them visible to new council launches without needing to actively monitor the market.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Position auto-invest as a low-effort way to rejoin the council category, with clear controls and reminders that they can pause or edit their settings.

actionSegments.name: Category buyer: legacy, engaged
actionSegments.description: Category buyers who also hold company investments and have made a council investment in the past six months.
actionSegments.strategy: Treat as a live category audience for launch priority, portfolio-wrapped impact stories and repeat investment prompts.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Turns existing category momentum into repeat participation across future council offers.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Frame auto-invest as a convenience upgrade for people already showing recent appetite, with emphasis on staying allocated to the municipal pipeline.

actionSegments.name: Category buyer: councils only
actionSegments.description: Non-local council investors who do not also hold company investments.
actionSegments.strategy: Explain the council investment category clearly and build confidence around repeat participation across places.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Helps them build a broader council portfolio without needing to pick every individual place.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Use simple education: auto-invest as a way to participate in the category while keeping investment choices bounded and transparent.

actionSegments.name: Local: new supporter
actionSegments.description: New local investors with lower average council investment values, likely to include community participation and support-led behaviour.
actionSegments.strategy: Use local proof points, project updates and simple second-step journeys into another council investment.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Lets a first local investment become a small ongoing habit without asking for a large next decision.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Lead with ease and participation: small regular settings, local proof points, and the option to support future council investments automatically.

actionSegments.name: Local: new investor
actionSegments.description: New local investors with higher average council investment values.
actionSegments.strategy: Build confidence, show portfolio-level impact and encourage diversification beyond the first local council.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Helps them diversify beyond their first local council while keeping a similar investment discipline.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Position auto-invest as portfolio-building: a way to keep deploying into council investments as new opportunities open.

actionSegments.name: Local: legacy, engaged
actionSegments.description: Existing Abundance investors from issuing areas who have made a council investment in the past six months.
actionSegments.strategy: Use richer loyalty comms, reinvestment prompts and early visibility of the wider council pipeline.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Makes reinvesting into the council pipeline easier for people already active again.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Treat as a loyalty/convenience message: auto-invest reduces friction and helps them keep cash moving into relevant new offers.

actionSegments.name: Local: legacy, disengaged
actionSegments.description: Existing Abundance investors from issuing areas who have not made a council investment in the past six months.
actionSegments.strategy: Use low-pressure reactivation, local outcome updates and reminders of open council opportunities.
actionSegments.autoInvestBenefit: Creates a simple route back into council investing without requiring them to follow every launch.
actionSegments.autoInvestStrategy: Use as a reactivation prompt alongside local impact updates, with a soft ask to set a modest auto-invest preference.
